title: A Rademacher exact type formula for pod$_2(n)$
summary: In this paper, we calculate an exact formula for the number of partitions of a natural number $n$, where the largest part is even and no odd parts appears more than two times. The generating functions of the number of these partitions is a mixed mock modular form of weight 0. In order to obtain the formula we apply an extended version of the circle method, during which we need to bound Kloosterman sums and similar exponential sums as well as Mordell-type integrals.
